culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total investments at fair value (amortized cost of $ 3,324,332 and $ 3,323,282, respectively) | 3,313,441 | 3,347,317

findings.detail: The identity check does not accommodate the filing's one-decimal percentage rounding; 3,313,441 / 1,542,673 x 100 = 214.78%, which the schedule correctly reports as 214.8%.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation resolves the flag as a check defect. The balance sheet investment fair value (table 6 row 7), schedule total fair value (table 14 row 24), and extracted total of 3,313.441 million agree exactly. The filing reports percentages to one decimal: total fair value divided by net assets is 214.78%, correctly displayed as 214.8%. Representative schedule rows likewise use one-decimal percentages, so a 33.33% tight-tier violation rate is expected rounding behavior rather than erroneous extracted values.
